title: Partial Boolean state transition
statement: For a state in the nested option type and an input bit, define a partial transition as follows: an absent state remains absent; a state of the form “present, then absent” becomes the input bit stored inside two present option constructors; and a state containing a bit produces an absent result when that bit equals the input, and otherwise produces an outer present constructor containing an absent one.
